title: Creamy Coconut Pastry
description: A rich Italian-inspired dessert combining low-fat coconut cream and creamy pastry. Perfect for warm weather, this treat provides a delightful twist on traditional Italian pastries.
instructions: Roll out the pastry sheet and place it on a baking sheet.
In a bowl, mix together the coconut cream and cream until well combined.
Add the sugar and vanilla extract to the coconut cream mixture and stir until smooth.
Spread the coconut cream mixture over the pastry, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Fold the edges of the pastry up over the filling to create a crust.
Bake the pastry for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown.
Remove the pastry from the oven and let it cool for 5-10 minutes.
Serve the pastry warm, garnished with powdered sugar if desired.
